Team,

Requesting quick approval to convert 3 field SDR positions into Solutions Engineer (SE) headcount on the NA field team. Summary and ask below — details attached.

Why: Q3 pipeline shows a material increase in opportunity complexity in mid-market accounts; SE support required to accelerate conversion and short-term ACV. We can shift two mid-tenure SDRs who already run technical discovery (Jordan M., Priya N.) and one open hire we haven't yet posted. Conversions reduce time-to-fill and preserve institutional knowledge.

Proposal (attached: conversion_list.csv, comp_band_matrix.xlsx):
- Convert 2 existing FT SDRs -> SE (effective on offer acceptance)
- Open one new SE req in place of an unposted SDR role
- Proposed comp bands (total OTE ranges): Base $95–110k, OTE $160–190k depending on territory and quota. Equity per SE: 0.05–0.12% annual grant; final bands per Marcus input.

Asks:
1) Approval to reclassify the three HC slots and move budget (headcount codes will be provided).
2) Sign-off on the proposed comp bands (or guidance on ceilings).
3) Permission to extend offers to two internal candidates (Jordan Miles, Priya Natarajan) at the bands above pending HR checks.

Timeline: aiming to issue offers by end of week (Friday) so ramp begins in Sep.

Attachments: conversion_list.csv, comp_band_matrix.xlsx

Thanks — please reply with yes/no or edits.

— Evelyn
